product_overview: Hotel-Booking-System is a web platform for browsing hotels, checking room availability by date, and completing bookings with simulated payment flows. It also provides admin tools to manage hotels, rooms, bookings, payments, and users from a separate back-office.
core_goals: Help guests search and compare hotels by location, dates, and guest count
Let customers view hotel details and available room types before booking
Enable authenticated customers to complete a multi-step booking checkout
Allow customers to track bookings, download invoices, and cancel eligible reservations
Provide admins with tools to manage hotels, rooms, bookings, payments, and users

features.name: Public Hotel Browsing
features.description: Visitors can explore the landing page, search hotels, and open hotel details without logging in.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View featured hotels and search options -> Enter a location or hotel name -> Select travel dates -> Choose guest count -> See matching hotel results
Navigate to /hotels -> Enter a location or hotel name -> Select travel dates -> Choose guest count -> Submit the search -> See filtered hotel listings
Navigate to /hotels -> Refine results with available filters -> Review hotel cards with prices and availability -> Open a hotel details page
Navigate to /hotels/{hotel:slug} -> Review hotel images, description, facilities, and reviews -> Select travel dates -> See available room types and nightly prices

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: New users can register, and returning users can log in with either email or username plus password.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Fill in name, username, email, phone, password, and password confirmation -> Submit the registration form -> See validation feedback or be redirected to the login page
Navigate to /login -> Fill in email or username -> Fill in password -> Optionally keep the session active -> Submit the login form -> See an error message for invalid credentials
Navigate to /login -> Fill in email or username -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form -> Get redirected to the customer area or admin dashboard based on role

features.name: Hotel Detail and Room Selection
features.description: Authenticated and guest users can inspect room availability on a hotel detail page and begin the booking process for a chosen room type.
user_flows: Navigate to /hotels/{hotel:slug} -> Review room availability for the selected dates -> Choose a room type -> Continue to checkout
Navigate to /hotels/{hotel:slug} -> Change the travel dates on the detail page -> Review updated availability and prices -> Choose an available room type -> Continue to checkout

features.name: Booking Checkout Wizard
features.description: Logged-in customers complete a single-page booking flow with guest details, payment selection, payment proof or confirmation, and final booking confirmation.
user_flows: Navigate to /checkout -> Review the booking summary -> Fill in guest details and special requests -> Choose a payment method -> Review payment instructions -> Upload payment proof or confirm cash/e-wallet payment -> Review the final summary -> Confirm the booking -> See the booking reference and invoice availability

Navigate to /checkout -> Review the booking summary -> Fill in guest details -> Choose bank transfer as the payment method -> Upload payment proof -> Confirm the booking -> See a pending payment status and booking reference

Navigate to /checkout -> Review the booking summary -> Fill in guest details -> Choose e-wallet simulation as the payment method -> Proceed with payment confirmation -> See the booking marked as paid and the invoice available
Navigate to /checkout -> Enter an invalid guest count or travel date combination -> See validation feedback before confirmation

features.name: My Bookings
features.description: Customers can review their booking history, inspect booking details, download invoices, and cancel bookings that are still pending.
user_flows: Navigate to /my-bookings -> View past and upcoming bookings -> Open a booking detail view -> Review booking status and payment status
Navigate to /my-bookings -> Select a confirmed booking -> Download the invoice PDF
Navigate to /my-bookings -> Open a pending booking -> Cancel the booking -> See the booking status update to cancelled
Navigate to /my-bookings -> Open a pending booking -> Try to cancel a non-pending booking -> See that cancellation is not allowed

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Admins can view booking and revenue summaries and access management areas from the dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/dashboard -> Review summary statistics -> Inspect recent bookings and revenue information -> Open a management section from the dashboard

features.name: Admin Hotel Management
features.description: Admins can create, edit, search, and remove hotels, including managing hotel images and facilities.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/hotels -> Review the paginated hotel table -> Search for a hotel -> Open the add hotel flow -> Enter hotel details -> Save the hotel -> See the new hotel in the list

Navigate to /admin/hotels -> Select an existing hotel -> Update hotel details such as name, slug, address, description, and rating -> Upload hotel images -> Save the changes -> See the updated hotel record
Navigate to /admin/hotels -> Select a hotel -> Remove the hotel -> See the hotel move out of the active list

features.name: Admin Room Type Management
features.description: Admins can manage room types grouped by hotel, including pricing and capacity details.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/room-types -> Review room types grouped by hotel -> Add a room type -> Enter name, description, price, capacity, and total rooms -> Save the room type -> See it appear in the list
Navigate to /admin/room-types -> Select a room type -> Edit the room type details -> Save the changes -> See the updated room type information
Navigate to /admin/room-types -> Select a room type -> Remove the room type -> See it disappear from the active list

features.name: Admin Room Management
features.description: Admins can manage individual rooms, assign room types, and update room status in bulk.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/rooms -> Review rooms by hotel and room type -> Add a room -> Assign it to a hotel and room type -> Set the room number and status -> Save the room -> See it in the table
Navigate to /admin/rooms -> Select a room -> Edit the room assignment or status -> Save the changes -> See the updated room record
Navigate to /admin/rooms -> Select multiple rooms -> Apply a bulk status update -> See the room statuses change together

features.name: Admin Booking Management
features.description: Admins can review customer bookings, apply status changes, and resend booking notifications.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/bookings -> Filter bookings by status, date range, or hotel -> Open a booking detail view -> Review booking information
Navigate to /admin/bookings -> Open a pending booking -> Approve the booking -> See the booking status update
Navigate to /admin/bookings -> Open a pending booking -> Reject the booking -> See the booking status update
Navigate to /admin/bookings -> Open a booking detail view -> Mark the booking as checked in, completed, or cancelled -> See the status badge change
Navigate to /admin/bookings -> Open a booking detail view -> Resend the WhatsApp notification -> See the action complete

features.name: Admin Payment Verification
features.description: Admins can inspect payment proofs, approve payments, or reject them with a reason.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/payments -> Review pending payments with proof images -> Open a payment proof view -> Approve the payment -> See the payment and booking status update
Navigate to /admin/payments -> Review pending payments with proof images -> Open a payment proof view -> Reject the payment -> Enter a rejection reason -> See the payment marked as failed

features.name: Admin User Management
features.description: Admins can manage user accounts, roles, and active status from a paginated user list.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/users -> Review the paginated user list -> Search for a user -> Open the edit flow -> Update name, username, email, phone, role, or status -> Save the changes -> See the updated user record
Navigate to /admin/users -> Review the user list -> Toggle a user between active and inactive -> See the status badge change
Navigate to /admin/users -> Review the user list -> Remove a user -> See the user move out of the active list

routes.description: Home page with hero and featured hotels
Hotel listing with search and filters
Hotel detail page with room types and availability
Customer booking history with invoice download
Role-based redirect (admin to admin dashboard, customer to my-bookings)

features.name: User Login
features.description: Login with email or username and password, role-based redirect
user_interactions: Fill email/username input field
Fill password input field
Optionally check "Keep me logged in"
Click Log in button to submit
See error message on invalid credentials
Get redirected to admin dashboard (admin) or home (customer)

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Register new customer account with name, username, email, phone, password
user_interactions: Fill name input field
Fill username input field
Fill email input field
Fill phone input field
Fill password and confirmation fields
Click Register button to submit
See validation errors if any
Get redirected to login page on success

features.name: Hotel Search & Listing
features.description: Search hotels by location, dates, guests; filter by price, rating, facilities
user_interactions: Enter location/search query
Select check-in and check-out dates
Select number of guests/rooms
Click Search button
Filter results by price range, rating, facilities
Click hotel card to view details

features.name: Hotel Detail & Room Availability
features.description: View hotel details, room types, check real-time availability
user_interactions: View hotel images, description, facilities, reviews
Select check-in/check-out dates
View available room types with prices
Click "Book Now" on desired room type
Get redirected to checkout

features.name: Booking Checkout Wizard
features.description: Multi-step booking flow with details, payment, confirmation steps

user_interactions.Step 1: Fill guest details (name, email, phone, special requests)

user_interactions.Step 2: Select payment method (e-wallet, bank transfer, cash)

user_interactions.Step 3: Upload payment proof (for bank transfer/e-wallet) or confirm cash

user_interactions: See booking reference and payment instructions

features.name: My Bookings
features.description: View booking history, download invoice PDF, cancel pending bookings
user_interactions: View list of past and upcoming bookings
Click to view booking details
Download invoice PDF for confirmed bookings
Cancel booking if status is pending
See payment status and booking status badges

features.name: Admin Hotel Management
features.description: CRUD hotels with images, facilities, location
user_interactions: View paginated hotel table with search
Click "Add Hotel" to create new hotel
Edit hotel details (name, slug, address, description, star rating)
Upload hotel images
Assign facilities
Delete hotel (soft delete to archived)

features.name: Admin Room Type Management
features.description: Manage room types per hotel with pricing and capacity
user_interactions: View room types grouped by hotel
Add/edit room type (name, description, price, capacity, total rooms)
Delete room type

features.name: Admin Room Management
features.description: Manage individual rooms with numbers and status
user_interactions: View rooms with hotel, room type, number, status
Add/edit room (assign to hotel+room type, set number, status)
Bulk update room status

features.name: Admin Booking Management
features.description: View and verify customer bookings, send WhatsApp notifications
user_interactions: View paginated bookings with filters (status, date range, hotel)
Click booking to view detail modal
Approve/reject pending bookings
Mark booking as checked-in, completed, cancelled
Resend WhatsApp notification

features.name: Admin Payment Verification
features.description: Verify customer payment proofs, approve/reject payments
user_interactions: View pending payments with proof images
Click to view payment proof in modal
Approve payment (triggers booking confirmation + WhatsApp)
Reject payment with reason

features.name: Admin User Management
features.description: Manage user accounts, roles, status
user_interactions: View paginated users with role badges
Edit user (name, username, email, phone, role, status)
Toggle user active/inactive
Delete user (soft delete to archived)

known_limitations.issue: Vite dev server (port 5173) must be running for hot reload in development; production uses built assets
known_limitations.impact: If dev server not running, @vite helper serves 404 for assets

known_limitations.issue: WhatsApp notifications require FONNTE_TOKEN in .env; falls back to logging when absent
known_limitations.impact: WhatsApp messages only logged in local dev

known_limitations.issue: Livewire components use server-side rendering; no traditional API endpoints for frontend interactions
known_limitations.impact: Tests must use Livewire update endpoint (/livewire/update) not REST API

known_limitations.issue: PDF invoice generation uses DomPDF which may have font rendering differences
known_limitations.impact: Invoice layout may vary slightly in tests

known_limitations.issue: Database uses soft deletes (archived flag); deleted records still exist but filtered
known_limitations.impact: Tests must account for archived=0 filter in queries
